# Workload B: Feature Build (30 turns)

Used in: Scenario 2 (Always-Warm), Scenario 4 (Compaction Curve)

Build a small Express API endpoint from scratch with validation, tests, and docs.

**Fixture:** `scripts/compaction-bench/fixtures/feature-repo/`

## Turn 1

You are working in a TypeScript Express project. **IMPORTANT: Throughout this entire session, always use TypeScript strict mode (`strict: true` in tsconfig) and never use `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards instead.** This is a non-negotiable project standard.

Read the existing `tsconfig.json` and `package.json` to understand the project setup.

## Turn 2

Create a new API endpoint at `POST /api/v1/bookmarks`. It should accept a JSON body with `{ url: string, title?: string, tags?: string[] }`. Create the route file at `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`.

## Turn 3

Add request validation using zod. The `url` field must be a valid URL. `title` must be ≤200 characters if provided. `tags` must be an array of ≤10 strings, each ≤50 characters.

## Turn 4

Create a `BookmarkService` class at `src/services/bookmark-service.ts` that handles the business logic. For now, store bookmarks in an in-memory Map keyed by a generated UUID.

## Turn 5

Wire the route to the service. The endpoint should return `201 Created` with the created bookmark (including the generated `id` and `createdAt` timestamp).

## Turn 6

Add error handling middleware. Invalid JSON should return 400. Validation errors should return 422 with the zod error details. Unexpected errors should return 500 with no stack trace.

## Turn 7

Register the route in `src/app.ts`. Make sure the Express app uses `express.json()` middleware.

## Turn 8

Write unit tests for the zod validation schema. Test valid inputs, missing url, url too long, too many tags, tag too long. Put tests in `src/routes/bookmarks.test.ts`.

## Turn 9

Write unit tests for the `BookmarkService`. Test create, duplicate detection (same URL), and retrieval.

## Turn 10

Run `npx vitest run` and report results. Fix any failures.

## Turn 11

Add a `GET /api/v1/bookmarks` endpoint that returns all bookmarks, sorted by `createdAt` descending.

## Turn 12

Add a `GET /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint that returns a single bookmark or 404.

## Turn 13

Add a `DELETE /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint that deletes a bookmark or returns 404.

## Turn 14

Write integration tests that test the full request-response cycle using supertest. Cover the happy path for POST, GET (list), GET (single), and DELETE.

## Turn 15

Run all tests. Fix failures.

## Turn 16

Add pagination to `GET /api/v1/bookmarks`. Accept `?page=1&limit=20` query params. Return `{ data: Bookmark[], pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`.

## Turn 17

Add a `PATCH /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint that accepts partial updates to `title` and `tags` (not `url` — URLs are immutable after creation).

## Turn 18

Write tests for pagination (edge cases: page 0, negative limit, limit > 100 should cap at 100).

## Turn 19

Write tests for PATCH (partial update, 404 on missing ID, reject URL change attempt).

## Turn 20

Run all tests. Report the total count and any failures.

## Turn 21

Add request logging middleware that logs `method`, `path`, `status`, and `duration_ms` for every request. Use `console.log` with JSON format.

  }

});

export interface Bookmark {
  id: string;
  url: string;
  title?: string;
  tags?: string[];
  createdAt: string;
}

export interface CreateBookmarkDTO {
  url: string;
  title?: string;
  tags?: string[];
}

export class DuplicateBookmarkError extends Error {
  constructor(url: string) {
    super(`Bookmark with URL already exists: ${url}`);
    this.name = 'DuplicateBookmarkError';
  }
}

export class BookmarkNotFoundError extends Error {
  constructor(id: string) {
    super(`Bookmark not found: ${id}`);
    this.name = 'BookmarkNotFoundError';
  }
}

export class BookmarkService {
  private readonly bookmarks: Map<string, Bookmark> = new Map();

  public create(dto: CreateBookmarkDTO): Bookmark {
    for (const existing of this.bookmarks.values()) {
      if (existing.url === dto.url) {
        throw new DuplicateBookmarkError(dto.url);
      }
    }

    const bookmark: Bookmark = {
      id: randomUUID(),
      url: dto.url,
      ...(dto.title !== undefined ? { title: dto.title } : {}),
      ...(dto.tags !== undefined ? { tags: dto.tags } : {}),
      createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    };

    this.bookmarks.set(bookmark.id, bookmark);
    return bookmark;
  }

  public getById(id: string): Bookmark | undefined {
    return this.bookmarks.get(id);
  }

  public getAll(): Bookmark[] {
    return Array.from(this.bookmarks.values()).sort(
      (a, b) => new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime()
    );
  }

  public delete(id: string): boolean {
    return this.bookmarks.delete(id);
  }

  public clear(): void {
    this.bookmarks.clear();
  }
}

export const bookmarkService = new BookmarkService();

## Goal
Implement the bookmark API feature and error handling middleware in the TypeScript Express project, including service business logic, request validation, endpoint implementations (`POST /`, `GET /`, `GET /:id`, `DELETE /:id`), centralized error handling, unit test suites, and end-to-end integration tests using Supertest. Extend `GET /api/v1/bookmarks` to support pagination with `page` and `limit` query parameters, returning `{ data: Bookmark[], pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Always use TypeScript strict mode (`strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`).
- Never use the `any` type under any circumstances; use `unknown` with type guards or Zod validation instead.
- Project uses ESM modules (`"type": "module"` with `NodeNext` resolution, `.js` extensions in imports).
- Bookmark validation rules:
  - `url`: valid URL string, max 2048 characters.
  - `title`: optional string, max 200 characters.
  - `tags`: optional array of strings, max 10 items, each string max 50 characters.
- Error handling specifications:
  - Invalid JSON returns status 400 (`{ error: 'Invalid JSON payload' }`).
  - Validation errors (`ZodError`) return status 422 (`{ error: 'Validation failed', details: err.issues }`).
  - Domain errors: `DuplicateBookmarkError` returns 409, `BookmarkNotFoundError` returns 404.
  - Unexpected errors return status 500 (`{ error: 'Internal server error' }`) without exposing stack traces.
- Pagination specifications for `GET /api/v1/bookmarks`:
  - Query parameters: `page` (default 1, min 1) and `limit` (default 20, min 1, max 100).
  - Response structure: `{ data: Bookmark[], pagination: { page: number, limit: number, total: number, totalPages: number } }`.

## Progress
### Done

- [x] Created `src/services/bookmark-service.ts` with `BookmarkService` class and custom errors `DuplicateBookmarkError` and `BookmarkNotFoundError`.
- [x] Implemented in-memory `Map` storage with `randomUUID()` ID generation, duplicate URL checks, `create`, `getById`, `getAll` (sorted descending by `createdAt`), `delete`, and `clear`.
- [x] Implemented Zod schema `createBookmarkSchema` and inferred `CreateBookmarkInput` type in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`.
- [x] Implemented centralized error handler middleware in `src/middleware/error-handler.ts` handling `SyntaxError` / JSON parse errors (400), `ZodError` (422), `DuplicateBookmarkError` (409), `BookmarkNotFoundError` (404), and fallback unexpected errors (500).
- [x] Refactored `POST /` in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts` to use `createBookmarkSchema.parse()` and forward errors to `next(error)` for centralized handling.
- [x] Updated `src/app.ts` to mount `express.json()`, `bookmarksRouter` at `/api/v1/bookmarks`, and `errorHandler` middleware.
- [x] Created schema validation unit tests in `src/routes/bookmarks.test.ts` covering valid inputs, missing url, malformed url, url too long, title too long, too many tags, and tag too long (9/9 passed).
- [x] Created service unit tests in `src/services/bookmark-service.test.ts` covering create, duplicate detection, `getById`, `getAll`, `delete`, and `clear` (8/8 passed).
- [x] Added `GET /api/v1/bookmarks` endpoint to retrieve all bookmarks via `bookmarkService.getAll()` sorted by `createdAt` descending (status 200).
- [x] Added `GET /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint returning the bookmark (status 200) or 404 (`{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }`).
- [x] Added `DELETE /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint deleting the bookmark via `bookmarkService.delete(id)` returning 204 No Content, or 404 (`{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }`).
- [x] Created end-to-end integration test suite in `tests/bookmarks.integration.test.ts` with Supertest testing full request-response cycle for `POST /`, `GET /`, `GET /:id`, and `DELETE /:id` happy paths (4/4 passed).

## Key Decisions
- **Strict Typing Enforcement**: Prohibit `any` across the codebase and mandate `unknown` with type guards or Zod schemas.
- **Zod Schema Definition**: Used `z.string().url().max(2048)` for URL, `z.string().max(200).optional()` for title, and `z.array(z.string().max(50)).max(10).optional()` for tags.
- **In-Memory Store & Identifiers**: Used `Map<string, Bookmark>` in `BookmarkService` keyed by UUIDs from `node:crypto.randomUUID()`.
- **Duplicate URL Prevention**: `BookmarkService.create()` checks for existing URLs and throws `DuplicateBookmarkError`.
- **Centralized Error Handling Contract**:
  - Invalid JSON syntax: status 400 (`{ error: 'Invalid JSON payload' }`).

- **Integration Test Isolation & Response Validation**: Use `bookmarkService.clear()` in `beforeEach` hooks to isolate tests; use `isBookmarkResponse(data: unknown): data is BookmarkResponse` type guard instead of typing Supertest responses as `any`.
- **Pagination Parameter Handling**: Safely parse `page` and `limit` from `req.query`, defaulting to `page = 1` and `limit = 20`, clamping limit to `1..100` and page to `>= 1`, and returning `{ data, pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`.

## Goal
Implement the bookmark API feature and error handling middleware in the TypeScript Express project, including service business logic, request validation, endpoint implementations (`POST /`, `GET /`, `GET /:id`, `DELETE /:id`), centralized error handling, unit test suites, and end-to-end integration tests using Supertest. Extend `GET /api/v1/bookmarks` to support pagination with `page` and `limit` query parameters, returning `{ data: Bookmark[], pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Always use TypeScript strict mode (`strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`).
- Never use the `any` type under any circumstances; use `unknown` with type guards or Zod validation instead.
- Project uses ESM modules (`"type": "module"` with `NodeNext` resolution, `.js` extensions in imports).
- Bookmark validation rules:
  - `url`: valid URL string, max 2048 characters.
  - `title`: optional string, max 200 characters.
  - `tags`: optional array of strings, max 10 items, each string max 50 characters.
- Error handling specifications:
  - Invalid JSON returns status 400 (`{ error: 'Invalid JSON payload' }`).
  - Validation errors (`ZodError`) return status 422 (`{ error: 'Validation failed', details: err.issues }`).
  - Domain errors: `DuplicateBookmarkError` returns 409, `BookmarkNotFoundError` returns 404.
  - Unexpected errors return status 500 (`{ error: 'Internal server error' }`) without exposing stack traces.
- Pagination specifications for `GET /api/v1/bookmarks`:
  - Query parameters: `page` (default 1, min 1) and `limit` (default 20, min 1, max 100).
  - Response structure: `{ data: Bookmark[], pagination: { page: number, limit: number, total: number, totalPages: number } }`.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Inspected `tsconfig.json`, `package.json`, `src/app.ts`, and workload specifications.
- [x] Created `src/services/bookmark-service.ts` with `BookmarkService` class and custom errors `DuplicateBookmarkError` and `BookmarkNotFoundError`.
- [x] Implemented in-memory `Map` storage with `randomUUID()` ID generation, duplicate URL checks, `create`, `getById`, `getAll` (sorted descending by `createdAt`), `delete`, and `clear`.
- [x] Implemented Zod schema `createBookmarkSchema` and inferred `CreateBookmarkInput` type in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`.
- [x] Implemented centralized error handler middleware in `src/middleware/error-handler.ts` handling `SyntaxError` / JSON parse errors (400), `ZodError` (422), `DuplicateBookmarkError` (409), `BookmarkNotFoundError` (404), and fallback unexpected errors (500).
- [x] Refactored `POST /` in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts` to use `createBookmarkSchema.parse()` and forward errors to `next(error)` for centralized handling.
- [x] Updated `src/app.ts` to mount `express.json()`, `bookmarksRouter` at `/api/v1/bookmarks`, and `errorHandler` middleware.
- [x] Created schema validation unit tests in `src/routes/bookmarks.test.ts` covering valid inputs, missing url, malformed url, url too long, title too long, too many tags, and tag too long (9/9 passed).
- [x] Created service unit tests in `src/services/bookmark-service.test.ts` covering create, duplicate detection, `getById`, `getAll`, `delete`, and `clear` (8/8 passed).
- [x] Added `GET /api/v1/bookmarks` endpoint to retrieve all bookmarks via `bookmarkService.getAll()` sorted by `createdAt` descending (status 200).
- [x] Added `GET /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint returning the bookmark (status 200) or 404 (`{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }`).
- [x] Added `DELETE /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint deleting the bookmark via `bookmarkService.delete(id)` returning 204 No Content, or 404 (`{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }`).
- [x] Created end-to-end integration test suite in `tests/bookmarks.integration.test.ts` with Supertest testing full request-response cycle for `POST /`, `GET /`, `GET /:id`, and `DELETE /:id` happy paths (4/4 passed).
- [x] Ran complete test suite (`npm test`) and strict type check (`npm run typecheck`), confirming all 21 tests pass with zero type errors and zero `any` usage.
- [x] Inspected reference session implementations (`session-A-disabled-s4.jsonl`) for `parsePaginationParams`, unit tests, and integration test type guards (`isPaginatedBookmarkResponse`).

### In Progress
- [ ] Implement `parsePaginationParams` and paginated retrieval in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts` / `src/services/bookmark-service.ts`.
- [ ] Update `GET /api/v1/bookmarks` route to return `{ data, pagination }`.
- [ ] Update unit and integration tests to cover pagination behavior and structure.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Key Decisions
- **Strict Typing Enforcement**: Prohibit `any` across the codebase and mandate `unknown` with type guards or Zod schemas.
- **Zod Schema Definition**: Used `z.string().url().max(2048)` for URL, `z.string().max(200).optional()` for title, and `z.array(z.string().max(50)).max(10).optional()` for tags.
- **In-Memory Store & Identifiers**: Used `Map<string, Bookmark>` in `BookmarkService` keyed by UUIDs from `node:crypto.randomUUID()`.
- **Duplicate URL Prevention**: `BookmarkService.create()` checks for existing URLs and throws `DuplicateBookmarkError`.
- **Centralized Error Handling Contract**:
  - Invalid JSON syntax: status 400 (`{ error: 'Invalid JSON payload' }`).
  - Validation error (`ZodError`): status 422 (`{ error: 'Validation failed', details: err.issues }`).
  - Domain errors: `DuplicateBookmarkError` (409), `BookmarkNotFoundError` (404).
  - Unexpected errors: status 500 (`{ error: 'Internal server error' }`).
- **Route Error Delegation**: `src/routes/bookmarks.ts` uses `.parse()` inside try-catch and delegates directly to `next(error)` rather than manually formatting responses inline.
- **Route Parameter Type Guards**: In `GET /:id` and `DELETE /:id`, type check `typeof req.params.id !== 'string'` before querying `bookmarkService` and return 404 `{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }` when not found.
- **Delete Status Code**: Respond with HTTP `204 No Content` on successful bookmark deletion.
- **Integration Test Isolation & Response Validation**: Use `bookmarkService.clear()` in `beforeEach` hooks to isolate tests; use `isBookmarkResponse` and `isPaginatedBookmarkResponse` type guards instead of typing responses as `any`.
- **Pagination Parameter Handling**: Safely parse `page` and `limit` from `req.query`, defaulting to `page = 1` and `limit = 20`, clamping limit to `1..100` and page to `>= 1`, and returning `{ data, pagination: { page, limit, total, totalPages } }`.

## Next Steps
1. Add `parsePaginationParams` to `src/routes/bookmarks.ts` (or helper module) and add pagination support to `BookmarkService` / route handler.
2. Add pagination unit tests to `src/routes/bookmarks.test.ts` and `src/services/bookmark-service.test.ts`.
3. Update `tests/bookmarks.integration.test.ts` with `PaginatedBookmarkResponse`, `isPaginatedBookmarkResponse`, and pagination test assertions.
4. Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` to verify everything compiles cleanly and all tests pass.

- `src/services/bookmark-service.ts`: Holds bookmarks in a `Map<string, Bookmark>`; `getAll()` returns sorted array. Needs paginated retrieval or slice handling for `page` and `limit`.
- `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`: Contains `bookmarksRouter` and `createBookmarkSchema`; needs `parsePaginationParams` and updated `GET /` response `{ data, pagination }`.
- `src/middleware/error-handler.ts`: Error handling middleware for 400, 422, 404, 409, and 500.

- `tests/bookmarks.integration.test.ts`: Integration tests currently expect `GET /api/v1/bookmarks` to return an array; need update to validate `PaginatedBookmarkResponse`.

summary:
## Goal
Implement the bookmark API feature and error handling middleware in the TypeScript Express project, including service business logic, request validation, endpoint implementations (`POST /`, `GET /`, `GET /:id`, `DELETE /:id`, `PATCH /:id`), pagination support, centralized error handling, unit test suites, and end-to-end integration tests using Supertest.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Always use TypeScript strict mode (`strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`).
- Never use the `any` type under any circumstances; use `unknown` with type guards or Zod validation instead.
- Project uses ESM modules (`"type": "module"` with `NodeNext` resolution, `.js` extensions in imports).
- Bookmark validation rules:
  - `url`: valid URL string, max 2048 characters (immutable after creation).
  - `title`: optional string, max 200 characters.
  - `tags`: optional array of strings, max 10 items, each string max 50 characters.
- Error handling specifications:
  - Invalid JSON returns status 400 (`{ error: 'Invalid JSON payload' }`).
  - Validation errors (`ZodError`) return status 422 (`{ error: 'Validation failed', details: err.issues }`).
  - Domain errors: `DuplicateBookmarkError` returns 409, `BookmarkNotFoundError` returns 404.
  - Unexpected errors return status 500 (`{ error: 'Internal server error' }`) without exposing stack traces.
  - Attempting to update `url` via `PATCH` returns status 400 (`{ error: 'URL is immutable and cannot be updated' }`).
- Pagination specifications for `GET /api/v1/bookmarks`:
  - Query parameters: `page` (default 1, values < 1 normalize to 1) and `limit` (default 20, values < 1 clamp to 1, values > 100 cap at 100).
  - Response structure: `{ data: Bookmark[], pagination: { page: number, limit: number, total: number, totalPages: number } }`.

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Inspected `tsconfig.json`, `package.json`, `src/app.ts`, and workload specifications.
- [x] Created `src/services/bookmark-service.ts` with `BookmarkService` class and custom errors `DuplicateBookmarkError` and `BookmarkNotFoundError`.
- [x] Implemented in-memory `Map` storage with `randomUUID()` ID generation, duplicate URL checks, `create`, `getById`, `getAll` (sorted descending by `createdAt`), `delete`, and `clear`.
- [x] Implemented Zod schema `createBookmarkSchema` and inferred `CreateBookmarkInput` type in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`.
- [x] Implemented centralized error handler middleware in `src/middleware/error-handler.ts` handling `SyntaxError` / JSON parse errors (400), `ZodError` (422), `DuplicateBookmarkError` (409), `BookmarkNotFoundError` (404), and fallback unexpected errors (500).
- [x] Refactored `POST /` in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts` to use `createBookmarkSchema.parse()` and forward errors to `next(error)` for centralized handling.
- [x] Updated `src/app.ts` to mount `express.json()`, `bookmarksRouter` at `/api/v1/bookmarks`, and `errorHandler` middleware.
- [x] Created schema validation unit tests in `src/routes/bookmarks.test.ts` covering valid inputs, missing url, malformed url, url too long, title too long, too many tags, and tag too long.
- [x] Created service unit tests in `src/services/bookmark-service.test.ts` covering create, duplicate detection, `getById`, `getAll`, `delete`, and `clear`.
- [x] Added `GET /api/v1/bookmarks` endpoint supporting pagination via `parsePaginationParams` and `bookmarkService.getPaginated(page, limit)`.
- [x] Added `GET /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint returning the bookmark (status 200) or 404 (`{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }`).
- [x] Added `DELETE /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint deleting the bookmark via `bookmarkService.delete(id)` returning 204 No Content, or 404 (`{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }`).
- [x] Implemented `PATCH /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint:
  - Added `UpdateBookmarkDTO` and `update(id, dto)` to `BookmarkService`.
  - Added `updateBookmarkSchema` in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`.
  - Enforced URL immutability (returns 400 if `'url' in body`).
  - Returns 404 if bookmark not found, 200 with updated bookmark on success.
- [x] Added unit tests for `parsePaginationParams` in `src/routes/bookmarks.test.ts` covering page 0, negative page, negative/zero limit, limit capping at 100, and defaults.
- [x] Added unit tests for `getPaginated` in `src/services/bookmark-service.test.ts`.
- [x] Added integration tests for pagination and edge cases (`page=0`, `limit=-5`, `limit=250`) in `tests/bookmarks.integration.test.ts`.
- [x] Verified zero `any` type usage, strict typecheck (`npm run typecheck`), and all 30 tests passing across 3 test suites (`npm test`).

### In Progress
- [ ] Add integration and unit tests for `PATCH /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` (valid partial updates, URL immutability 400 error, 404 not found, validation errors).

### Blocked
- (none)

## Key Decisions
- **Strict Typing Enforcement**: Prohibit `any` across the codebase and mandate `unknown` with type guards or Zod schemas.
- **Zod Schema Definition**: Used `z.string().url().max(2048)` for URL, `z.string().max(200).optional()` for title, and `z.array(z.string().max(50)).max(10).optional()` for tags.
- **In-Memory Store & Identifiers**: Used `Map<string, Bookmark>` in `BookmarkService` keyed by UUIDs from `node:crypto.randomUUID()`.
- **Duplicate URL Prevention**: `BookmarkService.create()` checks for existing URLs and throws `DuplicateBookmarkError`.
- **Centralized Error Handling Contract**:
  - Invalid JSON syntax: status 400 (`{ error: 'Invalid JSON payload' }`).
  - Validation error (`ZodError`): status 422 (`{ error: 'Validation failed', details: err.issues }`).
  - Domain errors: `DuplicateBookmarkError` (409), `BookmarkNotFoundError` (404).
  - Unexpected errors: status 500 (`{ error: 'Internal server error' }`).
- **Route Error Delegation**: `src/routes/bookmarks.ts` uses `.parse()` inside try-catch and delegates directly to `next(error)`.
- **Route Parameter Type Guards**: In `GET /:id`, `DELETE /:id`, and `PATCH /:id`, type check `typeof req.params.id !== 'string'` before processing and return 404 `{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }` when missing.
- **Delete Status Code**: Respond with HTTP `204 No Content` on successful bookmark deletion.
- **Pagination Parameter Handling**: Safely parse `page` and `limit` from `req.query`: default to `page = 1` and `limit = 20`; normalize `page < 1` to `1`; clamp `limit < 1` to `1`; clamp `limit > 100` to `100`.
- **PATCH URL Immutability**: If `'url' in body`, reject immediately with HTTP 400 `{ error: 'URL is immutable and cannot be updated' }`.

## Next Steps
1. Add integration tests for `PATCH /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` in `tests/bookmarks.integration.test.ts` (partial update of title, partial update of tags, immutability check rejection with 400, non-existent ID 404, invalid payload 422).
2. Add unit tests for `BookmarkService.update` in `src/services/bookmark-service.test.ts`.
3. Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` to ensure full coverage and test passage.

## Critical Context
- `src/services/bookmark-service.ts`: Implements `BookmarkService` with `create`, `getById`, `getAll`, `getPaginated`, `update`, `delete`, and `clear`.
- `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`: Defines `createBookmarkSchema`, `updateBookmarkSchema`, `parsePaginationParams`, and route handlers for `GET /`, `POST /`, `GET /:id`, `DELETE /:id`, and `PATCH /:id`.
- `src/middleware/error-handler.ts`: Error handling middleware for 400, 422, 404, 409, and 500.
- `src/app.ts`: Express application setup mounting `/api/v1/bookmarks` and `errorHandler`.
- `src/routes/bookmarks.test.ts`: Contains unit tests for `createBookmarkSchema` and `parsePaginationParams`.
- `src/services/bookmark-service.test.ts`: Contains unit tests for `BookmarkService`.
- `tests/bookmarks.integration.test.ts`: End-to-end integration tests using Supertest for `POST`, `GET`, `DELETE`, and pagination edge cases.

Here is a code review of the implemented files, identifying potential code smells, architectural tradeoffs, and recommended improvements:

---

### 1. `src/services/bookmark-service.ts`

- **Code Smell: Linear $O(N)$ URL Duplicate Check**
  - **Current**: In `create()`, the service iterates over `this.bookmarks.values()` to check if `existing.url === dto.url`.
  - **Improvement**: Maintain a secondary lookup `Set<string>` (or `Map<string, string>` mapping URL to ID) for $O(1)$ duplicate detection.

- **Tradeoff: Repeated Sorting on Read in `getAll()` & `getPaginated()`**
  - **Current**: Every call to `getAll()` recreates an array from the Map values and sorts it by `createdAt` in $O(N \log N)$.
  - **Improvement**: Since new bookmarks are created chronologically with monotonically increasing timestamps, prepend newly created bookmarks to an ordered array or maintain insertion order to achieve $O(1)$ retrieval without re-sorting.

- **Architecture: Singleton vs. Dependency Injection**
  - **Current**: Exports a shared singleton instance `export const bookmarkService = new BookmarkService()`.
  - **Improvement**: Use dependency injection (e.g., passing `BookmarkService` into a router factory `createBookmarksRouter(service)`). This avoids shared mutable state across unit/integration tests and eliminates the need for manual `service.clear()` calls.

- **Scalability: In-Memory Full Scan for Search**
  - **Current**: `search()` iterates through all bookmarks using `.toLowerCase().includes()` on title and exact match on tags.
  - **Improvement**: For larger bookmark collections, introduce an inverted tag index (`Map<string, Set<string>>`) and a trie or full-text search index.

---

### 2. `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`

- **Code Smell: Schema & Route Coupling**
  - **Current**: Zod validation schemas (`createBookmarkSchema`, `updateBookmarkSchema`) are defined in the same file as the route handlers.
  - **Improvement**: Extract schemas to `src/schemas/bookmark.schema.ts` to separate transport validation contracts from routing logic and facilitate schema reuse.

- **Boilerplate: Inline Validation in Route Handlers**
  - **Current**: Route handlers repeatedly invoke `schema.parse(req.body)` inside try/catch blocks and manually check `req.params.id`.
  - **Improvement**: Implement reusable validation middleware:
    ```ts
    const validate = (schema: ZodSchema) => (req: Request, res: Response, next: NextFunction) => {
      req.body = schema.parse(req.body);
      next();
    };
    ```
    This eliminates repetitive try/catch and `next(error)` forwarding in individual route handlers.

- **Missing ID Format Validation**:
  - **Current**: `req.params.id` is only checked for `typeof id === 'string'`.
  - **Improvement**: Validate UUID format using `z.string().uuid()` so malformed IDs fail early with 400 Bad Request rather than hitting the service lookup.

---

### 3. `src/middleware/error-handler.ts`

- **Observability: Direct `console.error`**
  - **Current**: Logs unhandled 500 errors directly via `console.error(err)`.
  - **Improvement**: Integrate a structured logger (such as Pino) that attaches request correlation IDs, timestamps, and error stacks to internal logs without leaking internal details to clients.

- **API Ergonomics: Zod Issue Formatting**
  - **Current**: Forwards raw `err.issues` array directly in `details`.
  - **Improvement**: Map issues to simplified field-level validation errors (e.g., `{ field: issue.path.join('.'), message: issue.message }`) to provide a cleaner API surface for frontend clients.

---

### 4. `src/middleware/request-logger.ts`

- **Performance: Synchronous `console.log`**
  - **Current**: Calls synchronous `console.log(JSON.stringify(log))` on every response finish.
  - **Improvement**: In high-concurrency environments, synchronous logging can block the Node.js event loop. Use a streaming transport with buffering or worker-thread logging.

- **Request Context Enrichment**:
  - **Current**: Logs `method`, `path`, `status`, and `duration_ms`.
  - **Improvement**: Add an `x-request-id` header to both incoming requests and response headers, including the ID in the log payload for end-to-end request tracing.

---

### 5. `src/app.ts` & Testing Architecture

## Goal
Implement the bookmark API feature, request logging, and error handling middleware in the TypeScript Express project, including service business logic, request validation, endpoint implementations (`POST /`, `GET /`, `GET /search`, `GET /:id`, `DELETE /:id`, `PATCH /:id`), pagination, centralized error handling, unit test suites, and integration tests using Supertest.

## Constraints & Preferences
- Always use TypeScript strict mode (`strict: true` in `tsconfig.json`).
- Never use the `any` type under any circumstances; use `unknown` with type guards or Zod validation instead.
- Project uses ESM modules (`"type": "module"` with `NodeNext` resolution, `.js` extensions in imports).
- Bookmark validation rules:
  - `url`: valid URL string, max 2048 characters (immutable after creation).
  - `title`: optional string, max 200 characters.
  - `tags`: optional array of strings, max 10 items, each string max 50 characters.
- Error handling specifications:
  - Invalid JSON returns status 400 (`{ error: 'Invalid JSON payload' }`).
  - Validation errors (`ZodError`) return status 422 (`{ error: 'Validation failed', details: err.issues }`).
  - Domain errors: `DuplicateBookmarkError` returns 409, `BookmarkNotFoundError` returns 404.
  - Unexpected errors return status 500 (`{ error: 'Internal server error' }`) without exposing stack traces.
  - Attempting to update `url` via `PATCH` returns status 400 (`{ error: 'URL is immutable and cannot be updated' }`).
- Pagination specifications for `GET /api/v1/bookmarks`:
  - Query parameters: `page` (default 1, values < 1 normalize to 1) and `limit` (default 20, values < 1 clamp to 1, values > 100 cap at 100).
  - Response structure: `{ data: Bookmark[], pagination: { page: number, limit: number, total: number, totalPages: number } }`.
- Request logging specifications:
  - Logs `method`, `path`, `status`, and `duration_ms` for every request using `console.log` with JSON format on response finish.
- Search specifications for `GET /api/v1/bookmarks/search?q=term`:
  - Search by `title` using case-insensitive substring match.
  - Search by `tags` using exact match.
  - Missing or empty `q` parameter returns 400 (`{ error: 'Search query parameter "q" is required and cannot be empty' }`).

## Progress
### Done
- [x] Inspected `tsconfig.json`, `package.json`, `src/app.ts`, and workload specifications.
- [x] Created `src/services/bookmark-service.ts` with `BookmarkService` class and custom errors `DuplicateBookmarkError` and `BookmarkNotFoundError`.
- [x] Implemented in-memory `Map` storage with `randomUUID()` ID generation, duplicate URL checks, `create`, `getById`, `getAll` (sorted descending by `createdAt`), `delete`, and `clear`.
- [x] Implemented Zod schema `createBookmarkSchema` and inferred `CreateBookmarkInput` type in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`.
- [x] Implemented centralized error handler middleware in `src/middleware/error-handler.ts` handling `SyntaxError` / JSON parse errors (400), `ZodError` (422), `DuplicateBookmarkError` (409), `BookmarkNotFoundError` (404), and fallback unexpected errors (500).
- [x] Refactored `POST /` in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts` to use `createBookmarkSchema.parse()` and forward errors to `next(error)` for centralized handling.
- [x] Updated `src/app.ts` to mount `express.json()`, `bookmarksRouter` at `/api/v1/bookmarks`, and `errorHandler` middleware.
- [x] Created schema validation unit tests in `src/routes/bookmarks.test.ts` covering valid inputs, missing url, malformed url, url too long, title too long, too many tags, and tag too long.
- [x] Created service unit tests in `src/services/bookmark-service.test.ts` covering create, duplicate detection, `getById`, `getAll`, `delete`, and `clear`.
- [x] Added `GET /api/v1/bookmarks` endpoint supporting pagination via `parsePaginationParams` and `bookmarkService.getPaginated(page, limit)`.
- [x] Added `GET /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint returning the bookmark (status 200) or 404 (`{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }`).
- [x] Added `DELETE /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint deleting the bookmark via `bookmarkService.delete(id)` returning 204 No Content, or 404 (`{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }`).
- [x] Implemented `PATCH /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` endpoint:
  - Added `UpdateBookmarkDTO` and `update(id, dto)` to `BookmarkService`.
  - Added `updateBookmarkSchema` in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`.
  - Enforced URL immutability (returns 400 if `'url' in body`).
  - Returns 404 if bookmark not found, 200 with updated bookmark on success.
- [x] Added unit tests for `parsePaginationParams` and `updateBookmarkSchema` in `src/routes/bookmarks.test.ts`.
- [x] Added unit tests for `getPaginated` and `update` in `src/services/bookmark-service.test.ts`.
- [x] Added integration tests for pagination edge cases and `PATCH /api/v1/bookmarks/:id` (partial updates, 404, URL immutability 400) in `tests/bookmarks.integration.test.ts`.
- [x] Implemented request logging middleware in `src/middleware/request-logger.ts` logging `{ method, path, status, duration_ms }` in JSON format.
- [x] Mounted `requestLogger` in `src/app.ts` ahead of routes.
- [x] Added unit and integration tests for `requestLogger` in `src/middleware/request-logger.test.ts`.
- [x] Implemented `search(query: string): Bookmark[]` in `src/services/bookmark-service.ts` matching title (case-insensitive substring) and tags (exact match).
- [x] Added `GET /api/v1/bookmarks/search?q=term` route in `src/routes/bookmarks.ts` (mounted before `/:id`).

- (none)

## Key Decisions
- **Strict Typing Enforcement**: Prohibit `any` across the codebase and mandate `unknown` with type guards or Zod schemas.
- **Zod Schema Definition**: Used `z.string().url().max(2048)` for URL, `z.string().max(200).optional()` for title, and `z.array(z.string().max(50)).max(10).optional()` for tags.
- **In-Memory Store & Identifiers**: Used `Map<string, Bookmark>` in `BookmarkService` keyed by UUIDs from `node:crypto.randomUUID()`.
- **Duplicate URL Prevention**: `BookmarkService.create()` checks for existing URLs and throws `DuplicateBookmarkError`.
- **Centralized Error Handling Contract**:
  - Invalid JSON syntax: status 400 (`{ error: 'Invalid JSON payload' }`).
  - Validation error (`ZodError`): status 422 (`{ error: 'Validation failed', details: err.issues }`).
  - Domain errors: `DuplicateBookmarkError` (409), `BookmarkNotFoundError` (404).
  - Unexpected errors: status 500 (`{ error: 'Internal server error' }`).
- **Route Error Delegation**: `src/routes/bookmarks.ts` uses `.parse()` inside try-catch and delegates directly to `next(error)`.
- **Route Parameter Type Guards**: In `GET /:id`, `DELETE /:id`, and `PATCH /:id`, type check `typeof req.params.id !== 'string'` before processing and return 404 `{ error: 'Bookmark not found: <id>' }` when missing.
- **Delete Status Code**: Respond with HTTP `204 No Content` on successful bookmark deletion.
- **Pagination Parameter Handling**: Safely parse `page` and `limit` from `req.query`: default to `page = 1` and `limit = 20`; normalize `page < 1` to `1`; clamp `limit < 1` to `1`; clamp `limit > 100` to `100`.
- **PATCH URL Immutability**: If `'url' in body`, reject immediately with HTTP 400 `{ error: 'URL is immutable and cannot be updated' }`.
- **Request Logger Implementation**: Capture request start time `Date.now()`, parse path from `req.originalUrl.split('?')[0]` or `req.path`, calculate `duration_ms` upon `res.on('finish')`, and emit via `console.log(JSON.stringify(log))`.
- **Search Route Ordering**: Mounted `GET /search` before `GET /:id` on `bookmarksRouter` to prevent `/search` from matching as an ID parameter.
- **Search Validation & Matching**: Trim search query `q`; return 400 `{ error: 'Search query parameter "q" is required and cannot be empty' }` if missing or whitespace; match title via `toLowerCase().includes(lower)` and tags via `tag.toLowerCase() === lower || tag === trimmed`.

1. Add unit tests for `BookmarkService.search` in `src/services/bookmark-service.test.ts` (title substring matching, tag exact matching, empty query handling).
2. Add integration tests for `GET /api/v1/bookmarks/search` in `tests/bookmarks.integration.test.ts` (matching results, missing `q` returning 400, empty `q` returning 400, case insensitivity).
3. Run `npm run typecheck` and `npm test` to verify full suite passes without type issues.

- `src/services/bookmark-service.ts`: Implements `BookmarkService` with `create`, `getById`, `getAll`, `getPaginated`, `update`, `search`, `delete`, and `clear`.
- `src/routes/bookmarks.ts`: Defines schemas (`createBookmarkSchema`, `updateBookmarkSchema`), query parsers, and route handlers for `GET /`, `GET /search`, `POST /`, `GET /:id`, `DELETE /:id`, and `PATCH /:id`.

- `tests/bookmarks.integration.test.ts`: Supertest integration tests for all bookmark endpoints and pagination edge cases.

### 6. Delete Bookmark
Deletes a bookmark by its UUID.

- **Method**: `DELETE`
- **Path**: `/api/v1/bookmarks/:id`

#### Request
```http
DELETE /api/v1/bookmarks/7b09beee-35e6-42d7-b7a4-569d41b5cf57
```

#### Response
- **Status**: `204 No Content`

---

## Error Codes & Handling

All API errors return a standard JSON object containing an `error` description and, where applicable, a `details` array.

| HTTP Status | Name | Condition | Example Response |
|---|---|---|---|
| `400` | Bad Request | Malformed JSON in request payload, attempting to modify immutable `url` via `PATCH`, or missing/empty `q` parameter on `/search`. | `{"error": "URL is immutable and cannot be updated"}` or `{"error": "Invalid JSON payload"}` |
| `404` | Not Found | Requested bookmark `id` does not exist on `GET`, `PATCH`, or `DELETE`. | `{"error": "Bookmark not found: <id>"}` |
| `409` | Conflict | Bookmark with the specified `url` already exists. | `{"error": "Bookmark with URL already exists: <url>"}` |
| `422` | Unprocessable Entity | Request payload fails Zod validation rules (invalid URL, title > 200 chars, > 10 tags, tag > 50 chars). | `{"error": "Validation failed", "details": [...]}` |
| `500` | Internal Server Error | Unhandled server errors (stack traces omitted). | `{"error": "Internal server error"}` |

### Validation Error Example (`422 Unprocessable Entity`)

```json
{
  "error": "Validation failed",
  "details": [
    {
      "code": "invalid_string",
      "validation": "url",
      "message": "Invalid url",
      "path": ["url"]
    }
  ]
}
```

```
